summary: Deployed named-database rules were read on 2026-11-13 and allow unauthenticated writes to all documents. The local replacement denies all client writes and compiled successfully through the Rules API (HTTP 200, no issues). It has not been deployed. This score describes the currently deployed rules, not the proposed replacement.

findings.issue: The deployed recursive wildcard allows anyone to create, update or delete any document without identity or validation.
findings.recommendation: Apply the reviewed query-only rules to the explicitly named housing database after verifying legitimate consumers. Run ingestion under a separately authorized server identity. Review IAM independently because server IAM bypasses client rules.
